text: The initiative marks Nepal's first national AA framework and roadmap, shifting from reactive to proactive disaster risk management. It employs a two-step forecast trigger model and pre-arranged financing, proven in the 2021 pilot via CERF. The framework emphasizes a 'whole-of-society' approach, integrating markets, local governments, and communities, and recognizes the need for cross-border early warning systems.

metadata.solution_name: Integration of Anticipatory Action into Nepal’s National Disaster Risk Management (DRM) System
